about: Reference pins of popcorn.planted (synth_truths.py): the single base seed every random stream of the shipped reference set derives from (seed_law), the pinned constants, the map-average crossover rate that fixes r/mu for the recombining arms (the length-weighted mean of a human chromosome-21 genetic map, 1.9638 cM/Mb), the fitted epoch sizes of class TK2 with the achieved match of its normalized expected spectrum to TK1's at n = 4 and 6 (xi_target = TK1, xi_fitted = TK2, from expected_branch_sfs; reproduced to 1e-12 by the battery), the class and arm tables, and the library versions the reference truths and arm were generated with (bit-for-bit regeneration is expected only under these versions). Every generator takes this file as input; load_pins() returns it by default.
register: simulation: ploidy-1 Kingman/Lambda coalescents (msprime); diploid individuals = exchangeable-paired chromosomes
seed_law: sha256('<base_seed>:<tag>')[:4] -> 1..2^31-2; tags: truth:<cls>:n<n>, arm:<arm>:{calib,ancestry,mutation,refalt}; selftest stream prefixes tags with 'selftest:'
recomb_law: r_arm = mu_arm * (r_map_per_bp / mu_human); mu_arm = target_density / mean single-tree total branch length at the arm's n (CALIB_REPS=8 reps); for constant-N=2e4 Kingman at n=1000 this recovers mu ~= 1.25e-8 and r ~= r_map; multi-epoch and MMC classes rescale mu (and r with it) to hold the site density and the r/mu ratio — the population-scaled pins

map.source: length-weighted mean over chr21 of the UCSC recombAvg track (GRCh38 recombination-rate average, bedGraph, cM/Mb); only this mean is used, as a fixed constant of the reference set
map.usage: mean rate only: synthetic arms use a FLAT rate r = mu * r_map_per_bp / mu_human

note: written BEFORE any truth/arm generation; never regenerated
